messages:
maria: Starting a coordinated deploy touching router, runtime, console in the 00:00-02:00 UTC window. 3 waves, kernel pin for runtime.
sean: Which exact artifacts? Need tags for the rollout doc.
maria: router:v2.1.0, runtime:runtime-2026-03-kernelA, console:3.4.1.
katie: Reminder: console schema flag 'console-toggle' flips in wave 2. UI smoke required after flip.
maria: Wave sizes: 1=1%, 2=25% (schema flip), 3=100%. Gating: 20m stable/no critical alerts between waves.
sean: Rollback triggers: p95 latency +150ms for 10m OR error rate >0.8% for 5m.
infra-shephard: Also immediate rollback on any JVM OOM or runtime GPU OOM. Monitor KV cache miss >3x baseline for 10m.
maria: Added OOM and KV-miss triggers. Manual hold available.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduling wave 1 at 2026-03-25T00:10:00Z. Commands queued:
``
# pin and reserve
deploybot pin --service router --version router:v2.1.0 --window 00:00-02:00
deploybot reserve --service runtime --kernel kernelA --capacity 50
```
katie: I'll own UI smoke for waves 1 and 2.
sean: I'll bump trace sampling to 100% for first 5m of waves.
maria: I'll operate traffic shift. @infra-shephard please monitor infra alarms.
infra-shephard: Oncall watching, will post to #incidents on threshold trips.
sean: Preflight checklist: pins applied, runtime reserved, tracing up, canary GA.
katie: UI checks: login, embedding flow, settings.
deploybot: deploybot: wave 1 executed 2026-03-25T00:10:12Z. Canary instances: 12. Pins confirmed.
katie: Wave1 smoke: OK. No console errors.
sean: Traces stable, p95 steady, error_rate 0.05%.
infra-shephard: Infra OK. KV miss +10% transient then normalized.
maria: Scheduling wave2 (schema flip) at 00:40. If any gate fails we rollback to router:v2.0.8 and unpin kernel.
sean: Acknowledged, standing by.
katie: Ready for schema flip watch.
maria: If issues, hit :rotating_light: and we stop shift. Otherwise proceed to final wave.
